intro: Convert pounds (lb) to stone (st) cleanly for UK and Irish body-weight readings, fitness logs, medical records, and boxing weight classes. Under the British Imperial standard, 1 stone equals exactly 14 avoirdupois pounds, so dividing pounds by 14 gives decimal stone while the remainder gives stone and pounds. Enter any weight above or scan the full pounds-to-stone table below from 7 lb to 300 lb.
alsoWrittenAs: lb to st, pounds to stones, US lbs to UK stone, pound into stone
tableTitle: Pounds to Stone Conversion Chart (7 lb to 300 lb)
tableSubtitle: Pre-computed UK stone values calculated using the exact ratio 1 stone = 14 pounds (st = lb ÷ 14).
tableRoundingNote: Computed with the exact Imperial definition 1 st = 14 lb (1 lb = 1/14 st ≈ 0.07142857 st). Non-terminating decimals are rounded to 5 significant digits (up to 5 decimal places); multiples of 14 lb are exact whole stones.

workedExamples.title: Luggage & Kettlebell Weight (25 lb)
workedExamples.scenario: Convert 25 pounds into UK stone for gym equipment or baggage comparisons.
workedExamples.stepByStep: 25 lb ÷ 14 = 1.7857143 st (rounds to 1.78571 st, or 1 stone 11 lb).

workedExamples.title: Adult Body Weight (145 lb)
workedExamples.scenario: Convert 145 pounds into stone for UK health and fitness tracking.
workedExamples.stepByStep: 145 lb ÷ 14 = 10.3571429 st (rounds to 10.35714 st, or 10 stone 5 lb).

workedExamples.title: Heavyweight Benchmark (260 lb)
workedExamples.scenario: Convert 260 pounds into stone and remainder pounds for clinical or athletic records.
workedExamples.stepByStep: 260 lb ÷ 14 = 18.5714286 st (rounds to 18.57143 st, or 18 stone 8 lb).

mistakesAndEdgeCases.title: Decimal Stone vs. Stone and Pounds (st & lb)
items: Do not misread decimal stone as stone-and-pounds: 10.5 stone equals 10 stone 7 pounds (147 lb), not 10 stone 5 pounds (145 lb).
To convert decimal stone into stone and pounds, multiply the fractional part by 14 (for example, 0.35714 × 14 = 5 lb, so 10.35714 st = 10 st 5 lb).

faqs.question: How many pounds are in a stone?
faqs.answer: There are exactly 14 pounds in 1 UK stone (1 st = 14 lb). Conversely, 1 pound equals 1/14 of a stone, or approximately 0.07143 st.

faqs.question: How do I convert pounds to stone and pounds?
faqs.answer: Divide total pounds by 14. The whole number is the stone value, and the remainder is the leftover pounds. For example, 180 lb ÷ 14 = 12 remainder 12, which is 12 stone 12 lb (12.85714 st).

faqs.question: What is 145 pounds in stone?
faqs.answer: 145 pounds equals 10.35714 stone, or 10 stone 5 pounds (145 ÷ 14 = 10 remainder 5).

faqs.question: What is 260 pounds in stone?
faqs.answer: 260 pounds equals 18.57143 stone, or 18 stone 8 pounds (260 ÷ 14 = 18 remainder 8).
